text:
OPEN-KIOSK is an open-source clone of Fully Kiosk Browser focused on digital signage.

- **Stack:** Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + CameraX + Room + Hilt
- **Repo:** git@github.com:pedroberaldo87/OPEN-KIOSK.git‹revisar?›
- **Package:** com.openkiosk
- **Min SDK:** 28, Target SDK: 34
- **License:** Apache 2.0

**Why:** Pedro wants an open-source alternative to Fully Kiosk Browser specifically for digital signage use cases — displaying URLs on kiosk tablets/screens.

**Key design decisions:**
- Config via local drawer (swipe left, PIN protected) — no remote admin/server
- Sleep state machine: ACTIVE → DIM → SLEEP with configurable timeouts
- Camera motion detection uses Y-plane grayscale pixel diff (no ML)
- Lock Task Mode when device owner, immersive sticky fallback otherwise
- Single Gradle module with package-level separation (not multi-module)

**How to apply:** This is a greenfield Android project. All architecture decisions are fresh and intentional. Future work should follow the existing patterns.

Corrige ativação por câmera e morte do app no Fire
A tela acordava sozinha à noite e não acordava de dia; o tablet caía na
lockscreen de propaganda da Amazon com o app fechado. As duas causas eram
de código.

Câmera (acordava sozinha à noite):
- Movimento passa a ser medido DEPOIS de descontar o deslocamento global de
  luz (mediana das diferenças). A tela caindo de 20% para preto mudava o
  quadro inteiro e era lida como pessoa passando.
- Descarta os primeiros quadros após religar a câmera: a exposição
  automática ainda converge e o quadro inteiro muda de brilho.
- Limiar por pixel 15 -> 20, calibrado com o piso de ruído medido no
  aparelho (0,0025 contra limiar de 0,05).

Câmera (não acordava de dia):
- O modo pulsado comparava o primeiro quadro da janela com um de 10s atrás;
  agora zera a referência a cada pulso.
- Com o tablet na tomada a análise é contínua (sem vão cego); na bateria
  pulsa no intervalo escolhido nas configurações, que voltou a ser honrado.
- Corrida entre ligar e desligar: o bind assíncrono aborta se o stop rodou
  no meio.

App morrendo / lockscreen de propaganda:
- WebView antiga passa a ser destruída de verdade a cada recarga; antes
  vazava 48 instâncias por dia até o sistema matar o processo.
- KioskWatchdogService segura o processo e relança a activity quando algo a
  cobre, espaçando as tentativas de 5s até 60s.
- Sem activity anexada a máquina de estado congela: transição destacada
  gravava um SLEEP fantasma e o watchdog lia isso como "não acenda".

Outros:
- Decisão irreversível (pedir câmera, entrar em lock task) espera a config
  real do banco em vez de decidir com o valor de fábrica.
- Desmarcar um sensor nas configurações para o que já está rodando.
- Auto-refresh "desativado" (0) não agenda mais recarga em laço contínuo.
- Preferências ganham fonte única em KioskPrefs.
- Remove o controle de polling da câmera, que ninguém lia.

Verificado no Fire HD 8 (KFRAPWI): ciclo ACTIVE->DIM->SLEEP com 0 falsos
positivos, troca tomada<->bateria trocando o modo da câmera, app voltando
sozinho em ~9s quando coberto, 184MB PSS com 1 WebView.

Add multi-language support: English, Portuguese, Spanish
Auto-detect language from OS locale via Android resource qualifiers.
Manual override available in settings via SharedPreferences — read
synchronously in attachBaseContext before Hilt injection.

Language selector in settings drawer with options: Auto (system),
English, Português, Español. Changing language recreates the Activity.

All hardcoded strings extracted to string resources. Duration suffixes
and dropdown parsing refactored to use index-based lookup instead of
string parsing for i18n robustness.

Add energy management: pulsed camera in SLEEP, scheduled deep sleep
- ACTIVE: sensors off, normal operation
- DIM: continuous camera + sensors for fast wake response
- SLEEP: pulsed camera (1.5s capture every N seconds) + sensors
- DEEP_SLEEP: all sensors/camera off, touch-only wake

Pulsed camera uses clearAnalyzer/setAnalyzer to preserve previousFrame
between pulses — no bind/unbind overhead, immediate motion detection.

Deep sleep activated by configurable time range (e.g., 22:00-06:00),
not by inactivity timeout. During the window, DIM/SLEEP transitions
skip directly to DEEP_SLEEP. Touch still wakes instantly.

New config fields: cameraPulseIntervalSeconds, deepSleepEnabled,
deepSleepStartHour, deepSleepEndHour.

Fix sleep/wake, camera motion detection, and PIN toggle
Sleep/Wake (Fully Kiosk compatible):
- Simulate screen-off via brightness=0 + black overlay (no lockNow)
- FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON always active — Activity and sensors never suspended
- Black overlay with touch-to-wake in SLEEP state

Camera motion detection:
- Lower pixel threshold from 30 to 15 for low-light sensitivity
- Add error handling and logging in MotionDetectionManager
- Add diagnostic pixel value logging in analyzer
- Verified working on Fire HD 8 tablet via ADB logs

Sensors:
- Fix proximity debounce (init with currentTimeMillis, not 0)
- Add logging throughout SensorWakeManager
- Fire HD 8 has no proximity sensor — shake detection works

PIN toggle:
- Add pinEnabled field to KioskConfig (default: false)
- Settings drawer opens without PIN when disabled
- Toggle switch in Kiosk settings section

Fix sleep/wake to match Fully Kiosk behavior — never turn screen off at OS level
- ScreenStateManager: remove lockNow(), WakeLock, DevicePolicyManager dependency
- SLEEP now uses brightness=0 + black overlay instead of actual screen-off
- FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON always active — Activity and sensors never suspended
- Camera motion detection now properly starts in DIM/SLEEP states (was broken)
- KioskScreen: black overlay on SLEEP with touch-to-wake, disabled drawer gestures
- KioskViewModel: store LifecycleOwner ref, onCameraPermissionGranted() flow
- Fix onBackPressed lint error (MissingSuperCall suppression)
- Add project CLAUDE.md

Initial commit: OPEN-KIOSK Android kiosk browser for digital signage
Complete app scaffold with all core modules:
- WebView with crash recovery, auto-refresh, offline detection
- URL playlist with configurable rotation timers
- Kiosk Lock Mode (Device Owner + immersive fallback)
- Smart sleep/wake state machine (ACTIVE/DIM/SLEEP)
- CameraX motion detection for screen wake
- Proximity and accelerometer sensor wake
- Settings drawer with PIN protection
- Room persistence for configs and playlist
- Hilt dependency injection throughout

Stack: Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + CameraX + Room + Hilt
Min SDK: 28 (Android 9)
